# UIScale

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIScale")`

Scales its parent and everything inside it, both what is drawn and where a press lands. Use it for a window that pops open or a HUD the player can enlarge.

The parent takes up `Scale` times its size, and a layout it is in makes room for that. Everything inside it is laid out as if unscaled and then scaled with it, including offsets, text, corners and strokes. It can be tweened.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Scale` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The factor the parent and its descendants are multiplied by. |
